title: site-internal-publish: decouple click-dog.com from GitHub Pages + binary releases
description: Publish click-dog.com entirely from the private repo via an external static host (Cloudflare Pages default), with site-vN versioning and staging+prod channels, independent of vYY.MM.idx releases. Design authority: ai/prompts/site-internal-publish.md. Done when: public archive carries no site files; master->staging, site-vN->prod, GA-tag->docs-refresh all work once the operator wires secrets+projects; make update-public dry-run shows no site paths; docs match reality. STATUS 2026-07-22 (final code state): all code beads closed — B1 #370, B2 #371, B3+B3b #372, B2b #374, B3c #375; archive DONE-check verified clean; prod dispatch master-only guard shipped. Open: cd-6 (operator go-live), cd-9 (CI leak-guard backlog, needs operator ack), cd-5 (version-injection backlog).

title: B1: remove the site from the public export (export-ignore + leak backstop)
resolution: merged via PR #370 (commit cd26462); gates 6/6 incl. positive deletion-tolerance dry-run and negative leak test
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: the public archive still ships the entire site (docs/, overrides/, mkdocs.yml, requirements-docs.txt, .github/workflows/docs.yml); the publish backstop neither covers site paths nor tolerates the legacy-file deletions the first post-change publish will stage.
WHERE: .gitattributes:11-20 (existing internal-only block); scripts/publish-to-public.sh:125-132 (LEAKED backstop).
CHANGE: append export-ignore rules for docs, docs/**, overrides, overrides/**, mkdocs.yml, requirements-docs.txt, .github/workflows/docs.yml, .github/workflows/site.yml (pattern may pre-date the B2 file) with a comment that the site is internal-only; extend the backstop pathspec list with docs/, overrides/, mkdocs.yml, requirements-docs.txt, .github/workflows/docs.yml, .github/workflows/site.yml and add --diff-filter=d so staged DELETIONS of legacy public files do not abort the publish (RFC interrogation item 2).
DONE: git archive HEAD | tar -t | grep -E '^(docs/|overrides/|mkdocs\.yml|requirements-docs\.txt|\.github/workflows/(docs|site)\.yml)' prints nothing; scratch-repo dry-run of publish-to-public.sh passes with docs/** deletions staged.
TESTS: archive-listing grep; bash -n; end-to-end scratch dry-run (fake public repo seeded from pre-change origin/master archive, throwaway LOCAL tag v99.99.99, --skip-scan, then delete the tag).
DO-NOT-TOUCH: existing export-ignore lines (.gitattributes:11-20), Makefile, workflows, docs content; never push any tag.

title: B2: add .github/workflows/site.yml; reduce docs.yml to a build-only gate
resolution: merged via PR #371 (commit e7e0b3e); gates 6/6, actionlint clean, prod pin proven against v26.07.3; reduced docs.yml self-validated live on the PR
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: no deploy pipeline exists other than gh-pages; docs.yml still deploys on v* tags via mkdocs gh-deploy (docs.yml:51-67) with contents:write.
WHERE: new .github/workflows/site.yml; .github/workflows/docs.yml:1-67.
CHANGE: site.yml per RFC section 3 (staging job: master push on site paths -> build master -> deploy click-dog-staging; prod job: site-v* tag, GA tag guarded by !contains(ref_name,'-') + regex step, or dispatch channel=prod -> pin docs/+mkdocs.yml to latest GA tag via rm -rf + git checkout, re-overlay docs/assets/social-card.* from BASE, mkdocs build --strict, deploy click-dog project via npx wrangler@4 pages deploy site --project-name=X --branch=main --commit-dirty=true; secrets-gate step skips deploy with ::warning:: when unwired; prod concurrency group site-prod cancel-in-progress false; permissions contents:read; fetch-depth 0 + fetch-tags; commented Netlify variant). docs.yml: drop tags + master-push triggers and the whole deploy job; keep pull_request paths + workflow_dispatch validation; permissions contents:read; rewrite header comment.
DONE: both workflows parse; prod content-assembly proven locally against tag v26.07.3; staging build (mkdocs build --strict from branch HEAD) passes.
TESTS: yaml parse; actionlint if installable (go install github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@latest, best-effort); local simulation of the pin sequence + strict build, then git reset --hard HEAD && git clean -fd; never run wrangler/netlify.
DO-NOT-TOUCH: release.yml, ci.yml, claude*.yml, degradation.yml, Makefile, .goreleaser*; never push any tag.

title: B3: rewrite docs-publishing.md + spec/releasing/CLAUDE.md carryovers for the new model
resolution: merged via PR #372 (commits ea79443 + 9a4f243, merge 9b7be29); gates 6/6; legacy gh-pages flow confined to a marked decommission appendix
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: every publishing doc describes the gh-pages/tag-coupled model that B1+B2 remove.
WHERE: docs/development/docs-publishing.md (all 163 lines); docs/development/releasing.md:81-86 and :135-138; docs/development/specs/open-source-clean-slate-migration.md:39-58 (boundary table says the mkdocs site ships publicly) and :161-174 (Docs site / GitHub Pages carryover bullet); CLAUDE.md CI-workflows line ('docs.yml separately validates...') and the 'Docs site (click-dog.com)' bullet.
CHANGE: rewrite docs-publishing.md around the site.yml pipeline (channels, triggers table, prod pinning rule, site-vN convention, secrets-unwired skip behavior, local preview + social-card guidance kept, old gh-pages flow only in a clearly-marked legacy/decommission appendix); update releasing.md so a GA tag is described as refreshing prod docs via site.yml (no gh-pages ruleset caveats); update the spec so the boundary/carryover text says the site is internal-only and export-ignored; correct CLAUDE.md's two factual mentions.
DONE: grep -rn 'gh-deploy|gh-pages|pages-build-deployment' across docs/ and CLAUDE.md hits only the marked legacy appendix; docs describe site.yml exactly as B2 lands it (design frozen in RFC section 3).
TESTS: mkdocs build --strict (venv); the grep above; grep -rn 'ai/(decisions|findings|extended-context)' docs/ CLAUDE.md prints nothing; US spelling.
DO-NOT-TOUCH: workflows, .gitattributes, scripts/, mkdocs.yml nav, ai/, .beads/; do not reference ai/ paths from these docs.
NOTE: dependency edge on cd-3 added retroactively per PR #369 review observation 1 — merge order was enforced operationally (B2 merged and verified before B3).

title: B4: build-time version-injection fallback for the site
description: Backlog only — do not implement. Version links already resolve through github.com/coltconsulting/click-dog/releases/latest/... redirects, so no page needs a concrete version string. If a page ever must render one, add a build-time injection step in site.yml (e.g. sed a placeholder with the pinned GA tag computed in RFC 3.3.2). Reads the git TAG only, never GoReleaser output.

title: B3b: contributing-flow.md still presents the gh-pages model as current
resolution: fixed by commit 9a4f243 in PR #372 (merged 9b7be29); contributing-flow.md carries zero stale gh-pages/GH013 tokens; gates G1/G2b/G3/G5b all pass
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: B3's stale-model grep (G2) found docs/development/contributing-flow.md:66-71 describing the gh-pages/GH013 ruleset caveat as a current publishing concern; it was outside B3's mandated four files and was flagged, not fixed.
WHERE: docs/development/contributing-flow.md:66-71 (gh-pages/GH013 passage).
CHANGE: rewrite the passage for the decoupled site pipeline (site publishes from the internal repo via site.yml to Cloudflare Pages; the public repo carries no site and needs no gh-pages/ruleset carve-outs), preserving the section's actual topic (contributor flow).
DONE: grep -n 'gh-pages|gh-deploy|GH013|pages-build-deployment' docs/development/contributing-flow.md prints nothing (or only clearly-historical past-tense text); page reads consistently with docs-publishing.md.
TESTS: mkdocs build --strict; the grep above; scope = that one file added to PR #372.
DO-NOT-TOUCH: everything else. Same owner as cd-4 (docs surface), folded into PR #372.

title: B3c: publishing-docs micro-clarifications from PR #369/#372 reviews
resolution: merged via PR #375 (merge 9460ba9) after cd-10; gates 4/4; docs verified against shipped site.yml guard expressions
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: three accepted review nits. (1) PR #372 review: docs-publishing.md describes the GA prod gate as one regex, but site.yml gates in two layers (coarse job-level dash guard + hard in-job regex verify step that exit-1s on e.g. v1.2). (2) PR #372 review: 'site-vN ... annotated tags on master commits' reads as enforced; nothing checks annotated-ness — soften to 'by convention'. (3) PR #369 review: docs/development/agents.md (the agent/bd conventions entry point) lacks a pointer to the ai/ workspace convention.
WHERE: docs/development/docs-publishing.md (GA-gate + site-vN passages); docs/development/agents.md (conventions section).
CHANGE: add the two-layer-gate sentence (also mention the dispatch-prod master-only guard landing via cd-10); soften the convention wording; add a one-line agents.md pointer to ai/README.md for the ai/ layout.
DONE: docs match shipped site.yml incl. cd-10's guard; strict build passes.
TESTS: mkdocs build --strict; scope = exactly the two files; no links to gitignored ai/ paths (ai/README.md is committed and is the link target).
DO-NOT-TOUCH: everything else. Merge AFTER cd-10's PR.

title: CI leak-guard: automate B1's archive-clean assertion (needs operator ack)
description:
From PR #370 review (accepted as valuable): the export-ignore boundary + publish backstop are the last line of defense against internal->public leaks, but B1's G1/G5 verifications were one-off manual gates; a future .gitattributes or publish-script edit could silently regress them.
CHANGE (when acked): add a lightweight CI assertion that `git archive HEAD | tar -t` contains no site/internal paths (docs/, overrides/, mkdocs.yml, requirements-docs.txt, docs.yml, site.yml, docs/development/, openspec/, the two publish scripts), e.g. as a step in ci.yml's lint job or a tiny standalone workflow. Optionally also a scratch-repo backstop test (heavier).
WHY OPERATOR ACK: adds a check to every future PR (CI surface change) and touches ci.yml, which was do-not-touch for this initiative. Do not dispatch until the operator agrees where it should live.
DONE: a PR touching .gitattributes that reintroduces a site path fails CI.

title: B2b: harden site.yml prod dispatch (master-only) + document the pin coupling
resolution: merged via PR #374 (merge c47dee5); gates 4/4, actionlint clean; prod dispatch now hard-fails off-master refs
description:
WHAT'S MISSING: PR #371 review findings 2+3, accepted. (1) The prod job's 'Verify the triggering ref is deployable' step is gated `if: github.event_name == 'push'`, so a workflow_dispatch prod run from an arbitrary branch ships that branch's landing content to click-dog.com — drift from the RFC (3.3.1: dispatch-prod runs from master). (2) The pin step silently couples the GA tag's mkdocs.yml/docs/ with BASE's overrides/; a rename in overrides/ fails strict build only at deploy time — fail-closed but undocumented.
WHERE: .github/workflows/site.yml prod job (verify step + pin step).
CHANGE: make the verify step always run: workflow_dispatch requires github.ref == refs/heads/master (::error:: + exit 1 otherwise) and logs event/ref/sha prominently; tag pushes keep the existing regex checks. Add a short comment in the pin step naming the coupling and that `mkdocs build --strict` is the deliberate fail-closed gate before deploy.
DONE: yaml parses; actionlint clean; scope = site.yml only.
TESTS: yaml parse; actionlint; scope check.
DO-NOT-TOUCH: everything else (staging job, docs.yml, all other workflows).

title: OPERATOR-ONLY / do-not-dispatch: host ratification, Pages projects, secrets, domain cutover, Pages decommission
description: Blocks go-live, not code landing. All items are operator calls (vendor/domain/secret authority) — never dispatch to a worker. Details + defaults recorded in ai/decisions/ (session-local): 1) ratify host: Cloudflare Pages (charter default) vs Netlify; 2) create direct-upload projects click-dog (prod) + click-dog-staging, vendor Git integration OFF, production branch main; 3) add Actions secrets CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (Pages:Edit scope) + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID; 4) verify staging then cut site-v1 and verify prod on pages.dev; 5) move click-dog.com (add custom domain to prod project, point DNS, remove custom domain from this repo's GitHub Pages settings, verify TLS+content); 6) decommission old Pages LAST (disable Pages, delete gh-pages branch and docs/CNAME) once prod is confirmed. Rollback before step 6 = point DNS back at gh-pages.
